app.title: Show HN: My $300 embroidery machine needed a subscription, so I built my own app
app.description: A software application that interfaces with an embroidery machine to control operations without requiring a paid subscription.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and build the ZigZag executable
Connect to a simulated embroidery machine endpoint and verify command transmission
Run the CLI with '--help' and capture output
Execute a simple embroidery pattern command and confirm machine state changes
